title: Awesome cute
text: Awesome cute. This apron is of great quality and very cute.  The material is heavy and the machine embroidery is good quality.  This apron will last for years.  I bought to wear to my Bunco party which had a Halloween theme.  The "V" neck is flattering.  As noted by another reviewer, it does NOT wrap all the way around your body, but just hip to hip.  I'm ok with with that.  Also note, no pockets.  A great quality apron!
